target_customer: Fintechs and lenders that must verify new users for KYC and AML at signup
problem: Identity verification relied on document scans and long forms that lowered conversion; Cognito started from just a phone number to link a user to name, address, date of birth and SSN.

founders.name: Alain Meier
founders.background_notes: Later ran Plaid's identity product group after the acquisition.

technical_complexity.rationale: Required licensing and joining regulated data sources and phone carrier signals into a reliable identity record, which is integration heavy more than research heavy.

defensibility.rationale: Data source contracts took effort but similar identity vendors existed and the phone first method could be copied by well funded vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Cognito was acquired by Plaid in January 2022 for a reported 250 million dollars in cash and stock, and Plaid launched its own identity verification product within months using Cognito's products.

market_need_then: The company started as BlockScore in 2014 aiming to make verification as easy as Stripe made billing; fintech onboarding growth through 2022 created steady demand and customers such as Affirm, Brex and Current.

branding.domain_note: Brand lived on cognitohq.com, not an exact cognito.com domain

identity.voice_and_tone: Developer and fintech focused product copy

rebrands.why: Company said it learned much about identity data over three years and wanted the name to reflect that; later posts describe merging two brands on a new website.

brand_strength.rationale: Known mainly among fintech developers; the name is shared with unrelated products such as Amazon Cognito and other companies, and no brand coverage beyond the Plaid deal was found.

pivots.to: Cognito phone number first identity verification
pivots.why: Rename and product refinement after learning about identity data, per company post.

outcome_analysis: Cognito sold identity verification to fintechs starting from a phone number and was bought by Plaid in January 2022 for a reported 250 million dollars after raising very little disclosed capital. Plaid wanted identity verification to complete onboarding alongside account linking and funding, and the product was folded into Plaid Identity Verification, making this a capital efficient strategic exit.
notes: The 250M price was reported by press and not officially disclosed. Funding history not found: aggregators show roughly 2.1M to 2.25M across 4 rounds, a single aggregator figure and unverified, so no rounds are recorded; a cross-check search found nothing better. The competitor search returned only current marketing and later comparisons, so the list is empty. The Cognito site is live and shows Plaid branding, with BlockScore, Inc. in the footer. YC lists founded 2013, company site says 2014.
